info.text:
79% of pros lost to an index in 2025.

79% of active US large-cap funds trailed the S&P 500 in 2025, and a majority trailed every year from 2021 to 2025 (SPIVA).
Average fees in 2025: 0.64% for active stock mutual funds vs 0.05% for index stock mutual funds (ICI).
Example: $10,000 at 7% a year before fees for 30 years ends at $75,063 at 0.05% vs $63,584 at 0.64%: an $11,479 gap.
By end of 2023, US passive funds held more assets than active ones (Morningstar).

Sources: S&P Dow Jones Indices SPIVA U.S. Scorecards; ICI (2026); Morningstar.
News and education, not financial advice.
